en: {area} is one of the important marine fishing areas of the world. Using the FAO Global Capture Production statistics for {first_year}–{last_year} (release {release}), this report analyses the catch trends, the main species items and fishing countries, the status of the stocks and the quality of the data, with breakpoint analysis, stock status plots, Mann-Kendall trend tests and diversity and concentration indices. In {last_year}, the catch in the area was {total_last}, {share_last}% of the world's marine capture production. The catch peaked in {peak_year} at {peak_catch}, and the catch of {last_year} was {pct_peak}% of the peak. Breakpoints divide the catch series into {n_stages} stages ({stage_years}). In the last five years, {top1_species_plain} was the main species item, with {top1_species_share}% of the catch, and {top1_country} the main fishing country, with {top1_country_share}%. In {last_year}, {oc_pct}% of the stocks were over-exploited or collapsed. Monitoring and assessment of the main stocks, and the reporting of catch at species level, should be strengthened.
zh: {area}是全球重要的海洋捕捞海域之一。本报告根据联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）全球捕捞产量统计 {first_year}–{last_year} 年数据（{release} 版），采用突变点检测、资源开发状态图、Mann-Kendall 趋势检验以及多样性和集中度指数，分析了该海域渔获量的变化、主要渔获种类和捕捞国家（地区）、资源开发状态及数据质量。结果表明，{last_year} 年该海域渔获量为 {total_last}，占全球海洋捕捞产量的 {share_last}%；历史最高渔获量出现在 {peak_year} 年（{peak_catch}），{last_year} 年渔获量为峰值的 {pct_peak}%。渔获量变化可划分为 {n_stages} 个阶段（{stage_years}）。近 5 年{top1_species_plain}是最主要的渔获种类，占总渔获量的 {top1_species_share}%；{top1_country}是最主要的捕捞国家（地区），占 {top1_country_share}%。{last_year} 年处于过度开发或崩溃状态的资源占 {oc_pct}%。建议加强主要渔获种类的资源监测与评估，提高渔获统计的物种分辨率。

en: Following the FAO division of the oceans into major fishing areas, the catch data of {area} were analysed. The catch data are the FAO Global Capture Production statistics, release {release} {cite:fao_capture}, published by FAO on {release_date} and downloaded on {download_date} from {url}. They cover {first_year}–{last_year}, in tonnes live weight, and give the yearly catch of {n_countries} countries and territories and {n_species} species items in the area; aquaculture production is not included.
zh: 根据 FAO 对全球主要渔区的划分，选取{area}的渔获数据进行分析。渔获量数据来自 FAO 全球捕捞产量统计（Global Capture Production）{release} 版{cite:fao_capture}，该版本由 FAO 于 {release_date} 发布，本报告于 {download_date} 从 {url} 下载。数据时间范围为 {first_year}–{last_year} 年，单位为活重吨（t），包括 {n_countries} 个国家和地区、{n_species} 个物种条目在该海域的年渔获量，不包括水产养殖产量。

en: Species names, taxonomic levels and ISSCAAP groups follow the FAO ASFIS list of species. Definitions, classifications and coverage of the statistics are described in the latest FAO Yearbook of Fishery and Aquaculture Statistics {cite:fao_yearbook}. Coastal countries are those whose land, in the Natural Earth country outlines, lies within 20 km of the boundary of the FAO area.
zh: 物种名称、分类阶元和 ISSCAAP 类群采用 FAO 水产物种名录（ASFIS），国家、物种和渔区的中文名称采用 FAO 代码表中的官方名称。统计数据的定义、分类和统计范围参见最新的 FAO 渔业和水产养殖统计年鉴{cite:fao_yearbook}。沿岸国根据 Natural Earth 国界数据与 FAO 渔区边界的距离确定（20 km 以内）。

en: Breakpoints in the mean of the yearly catch were detected with the Bai-Perron structural change test {cite:bai2003,zeileis2003}, with a minimum segment length of 15% of the series, and used to divide the catch series into stages. The catch series of the main species and countries were analysed in the same way.
zh: 采用结构突变检验（Bai-Perron 方法）检测年渔获量序列均值的突变点{cite:bai2003,zeileis2003}，各阶段的最小长度为序列长度的 15%，并据此划分渔获量变化阶段；主要渔获种类和捕捞国家（地区）的渔获量序列采用相同方法分析。

en: Stock status plots {cite:kleisner2013} classify each species item every year as developing, exploited, over-exploited, collapsed or rebuilding, from its catch relative to the peak catch of its series. Only items identified to species, genus or family were included, with at least 10 years of data, 5 consecutive years with catch and a total catch of at least 1 000 t.
zh: 采用资源开发状态图方法{cite:kleisner2013}，根据各物种每年渔获量相对于其历史最高渔获量的比例，将资源状态划分为开发中、充分开发、过度开发、崩溃和恢复中 5 类。纳入分析的物种须鉴定到种、属或科，渔获序列不少于 10 年，连续有渔获的年份不少于 5 年，且累计渔获量不少于 1 000 t。

en: Trends over the last ten years were tested with the non-parametric Mann-Kendall test {cite:mann1945,kendall1975} (significant at *P* < 0.05); the mean annual rate of change was computed from the first and last of these years.
zh: 采用 Mann-Kendall 非参数检验{cite:mann1945,kendall1975}分析近 10 年渔获量的变化趋势（*P*<0.05 为显著），年均变化率按近 10 年首末两年的渔获量计算。

en: The diversity and concentration of the catch were described with the Shannon diversity index {cite:shannon1948} and the Herfindahl-Hirschman index (HHI) {cite:rhoades1993}: *H* = −∑*p*~i~ ln *p*~i~ and HHI = ∑(100*p*~i~)^2^, where *p*~i~ is the share of species item (or country) *i* in the catch of the year. An HHI below 1 500 is read as unconcentrated, 1 500–2 500 as moderately and above 2 500 as highly concentrated.
zh: 采用 Shannon 多样性指数{cite:shannon1948}和赫芬达尔–赫希曼指数（HHI）{cite:rhoades1993}描述渔获组成的多样性和集中程度：*H* = −∑*p*~i~ ln *p*~i~，HHI = ∑(100*p*~i~)^2^，式中 *p*~i~ 为第 *i* 个种类（或国家）占当年渔获量的比例。HHI 低于 1 500 为不集中，1 500–2 500 为中度集中，高于 2 500 为高度集中。
